# Old Town Village Blends Waxhaw Living with Design Excellence


Your Home, Your Timeline, Your Town


Tri Pointe Homes


•


September 18, 2026


Share this article


There’s something special about finding a place that feels like it has been waiting for you. Just outside Charlotte, Waxhaw offers the charm of a historic small town with the restaurants, shops, recreation and community events that make it an exciting place to call home. Tucked within this charming town is[Old Town Village](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/old-town-village) by Tri Pointe Homes®, a townhome community that brings together thoughtful design, modern comfort and a location just steps away from historic downtown Waxhaw.


For homebuyers looking for more than just a place to live, Old Town Village offers a new-home experience designed around the way you *want* to live.


## **Discover the Charm of Waxhaw**


Dating back to the 1700s, Waxhaw is one of[Union County’s oldest towns](https://www.waxhaw.com/our-town/history) and has maintained its small-town charm while continuing to grow. At the heart of the community is its historic downtown, which is listed on the[National Register of Historic Places](https://www.waxhaw.com/our-town/history) and filled with locally owned businesses, historic architecture, restaurants, retail shops, public art and community gathering spaces.


For residents of Old Town Village, experiencing Waxhaw can become part of their everyday routine. Spend the morning browsing local shops, like the[Mule Barn Mercantile](https://mulebarnmercantile.com/) , grab lunch at a favorite local restaurant, like[Emmet’s Social Table](https://emmetsnc.com/) , and end your day by strolling over the iconic[Waxhaw Foot Bridge](https://visitwaxhaw.com/directory/historic-waxhaw-foot-bridge/) . The town of Waxhaw also offers plenty of opportunities to enjoy the outdoors, from[Downtown Park’s](https://www.waxhaw.com/government/departments/parks-and-recreation/parks-facilities-trails/downtown-park) walking paths, fitness area, movie nights and summer concerts to[Cane Creek Park’s](https://www.unioncountync.gov/government/departments-f-p/parks-recreation/cane-creek-park) 1,050 acres of land surrounding a 350-acre lake.


Community is at the heart of everything that goes on in Waxhaw, with traditions that take place throughout the year. From summer concerts to holiday celebrations, Waxhaw brings neighbors together while preserving the character that makes the town unique.


## **A New Way to Experience Waxhaw**


What if you could enjoy all that small-town charm while coming home to a brand-new home designed for modern living?


That’s where Old Town Village stands apart.


Framed by trees and tucked away in a charming neighborhood, Old Town Village offers the best of both worlds: a peaceful place to come home to and walkable access to shops, restaurants and experiences of downtown Waxhaw.


The community features three-story townhomes ranging from 2,003 square feet to 2,350 square feet, with two to four bedrooms, 2.5 to 3.5 baths and two-bay garages. Open concept layouts create room to gather, relax and entertain, while outdoor spaces and covered porches extend the living space beyond the walls of the home. With fully maintained yards, residents can spend less time worrying about upkeep and more time enjoying their homes, their neighbors and everything Waxhaw has to offer.


## **What Makes Old Town Village Feel Premium?**


At Old Town Village, thoughtfully designed floorplans, generous living spaces, two-bay garages, outdoor living areas and curated architectural style give residents many of the features they want in a single-family home while maintaining the convenience and connectedness of townhome living.


Every Old Town Village home is designed with[LivingSmart®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/blog/living-smarter) features focused on comfort, wellness and sustainability that incorporate elements such as energy efficiency, water savings, smart technology and low-VOC materials. The community also reflects Tri Pointe Homes’[LiveAbility™](https://www.tripointehomes.com/different-by-design) approach, which focuses on thoughtful planning and creating homes and communities that support the way people actually live.


In other words, premium isn’t just about how a home looks. It’s about how it feels to live there!


## **Move In Sooner with Move-In Ready Homes at Old Town Village**


That feeling doesn’t have to wait on a build schedule. Old Town Village currently has move-in ready townhomes available, so you can skip the construction timeline and start enjoying Waxhaw sooner.


Each home is complete and finished with a curated selection of designer-chosen finishes, so you can walk in, picture your life there and get moving. Homes feature open-concept layouts, covered porches and two-bay tandem garages that define the community. Whether you’re relocating, downsizing or simply ready to stop waiting, a move-in ready home lets you picture your life here from the very first tour. See[what’s available now](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/old-town-village) at Old Town Village.


Thoughtful design is a hallmark of Tri Pointe Homes Charlotte, whose Design Studio was (for the second time) named the[Best Design Center/Showroom at the Major Achievements in Merchandising Excellence](https://www.tripointehomes.com/blog/tri-pointe-charlotte-wins-best-design-center-2026-mame-awards) (MAME) Awards’ 41 *st* annual ceremony, presented by the[Home Builders Association of Greater Charlotte](https://www.hbacharlotte.com/mame/) .


## **Your Home, Your Timeline, Your Town**


At the end of the day, finding the right home is about finding the right combination of place, lifestyle and connection.


Waxhaw offers the character, Old Town Village offers the new-home experience and Tri Pointe Homes brings thoughtful design and personalization together to create a place that can feel uniquely yours.


Here, downtown adventures start just steps from home, quiet mornings can begin on a covered porch and the home you’ve imagined can take shape through a design experience built around your own style.


Learn more at[https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/old-town-village](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/old-town-village) .
